questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Solve for x if 9^(x + 1) = 27^(x - 1).
questions.explanation: Convert both sides to base 3: (3^2)^(x + 1) = (3^3)^(x - 1) => 3^(2x + 2) = 3^(3x - 3). Equating powers: 2x + 2 = 3x - 3 => x = 5.
questions.explanation_pidgin: Carry both 9 and 27 go base 3: 3^(2x+2) = 3^(3x-3). Solve 2x + 2 = 3x - 3, you go get x = 5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the gradient of the curve y = kx^2 - 6x + 5 at x = 3 is 12, find the value of the constant k.
questions.explanation: Differentiating gives dy/dx = 2kx - 6. At x = 3, the gradient is 2k(3) - 6 = 12 => 6k = 18 => k = 3.
questions.explanation_pidgin: dy/dx na 2kx - 6. Put x = 3 make e equal 12: 6k - 6 = 12 => 6k = 18 => k = 3.
